_note: One-line diagnosis per misclassified test tweet, keyed by dataset row. make_report.py fills these into REPORT.md.
481: No negative words at all and a playful ':p'; the gold 'negative' label looks debatable (label noise), so neutral is a defensible prediction.
5017: Negativity is carried by irony ('And still ... talks about women empowerment') around a factual report full of names; the model reads the surface as news-like and neutral.
2512: Negation scoping: the model latched onto 'how great he is' and missed that 'Don't want to hear' flips it.
4768: Explicit 'Not happy' is outweighed by positive-context words (advance screening, see Paper Towns); BERT under-weights the negation at the start.
5144: A polite customer-service complaint phrased as a factual timeline ('was told... haven't got anything'); the grievance is implied, not stated with sentiment words.
